figs.name: arithmetic-logic-unit-block-diagram
figs.alt: arithmetic logic unit block diagram with adder, logic gates, multiplexer, select code and flags
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing an ALU: inputs A and B feed the arithmetic and logic units in parallel, and the select code makes the multiplexer pass one result with flags.
figs.after_h2: Inside the ALU: The Two Functional Halves
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 545" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Arithmetic logic unit block diagram with arithmetic unit, logic unit, multiplexer and flags</title>
<rect width="800" height="545" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Inside an Arithmetic Logic Unit</text>
<rect x="245" y="58" width="380" height="345" rx="14" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="8 5"/>
<text x="258" y="84" font-size="17" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">ALU core: combinational, no clock</text>
<rect x="25" y="110" width="150" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="100.0" y="134.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Input A</text>
<text x="100.0" y="157.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">n bit operand</text>
<rect x="25" y="320" width="150" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="100.0" y="344.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Input B</text>
<text x="100.0" y="367.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">n bit operand</text>
<rect x="270" y="100" width="220" height="100" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="380.0" y="132.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Arithmetic unit</text>
<text x="380.0" y="155.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">full adders:</text>
<text x="380.0" y="178.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">ADD, SUB, INC, DEC</text>
<rect x="270" y="290" width="220" height="100" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="380.0" y="322.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Logic unit</text>
<text x="380.0" y="345.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">AND, OR, XOR, NOT</text>
<text x="380.0" y="368.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">one gate per bit</text>
<line x1="175" y1="140" x2="268" y2="140" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="212" y1="140" x2="212" y2="320" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="212" y1="320" x2="268" y2="320" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="175" y1="350" x2="268" y2="350" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="236" y1="350" x2="236" y2="172" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="236" y1="172" x2="268" y2="172" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="550,120 610,160 610,330 550,370" fill="#ede9fe" stroke="#4c1d95" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="580" y="252" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">MUX</text>
<line x1="490" y1="150" x2="548" y2="150" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="490" y1="340" x2="548" y2="340" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="445" y="440" width="230" height="60" rx="10" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="560.0" y="464.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Select code</text>
<text x="560.0" y="487.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">3 to 6 bits</text>
<line x1="580" y1="440" x2="580" y2="355" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="655" y="200" width="130" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="720.0" y="229.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Result</text>
<text x="720.0" y="252.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">n bit</text>
<line x1="610" y1="235" x2="653" y2="235" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="655" y="310" width="130" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="720.0" y="339.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Flags</text>
<text x="720.0" y="362.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">C, Z, S, V</text>
<polyline points="610,300 633,300 633,345 653,345" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="530" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Both halves compute in parallel and the multiplexer passes one result</text>
</svg>

figs.name: arithmetic-logic-unit-flag-branch-flowchart
figs.alt: ALU instruction flowchart from select code to status flags and jump if zero branch
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how an ALU result and its flags drive a jump if zero branch, and how subtraction reuses the adder by inverting B with carry in 1.
figs.after_h2: Status Flags: The ALU's Report Card
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 590" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart of an instruction through the ALU and a jump if zero branch</title>
<rect width="800" height="590" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">From Select Code to Branch Decision</text>
<rect x="40" y="60" width="330" height="56" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="82.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Control unit sends</text>
<text x="205.0" y="105.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">the select code</text>
<line x1="205" y1="116" x2="205" y2="138" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="140" width="330" height="56" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="162.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Both units compute</text>
<text x="205.0" y="185.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">in parallel</text>
<line x1="205" y1="196" x2="205" y2="218" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="220" width="330" height="56" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="242.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">MUX passes the</text>
<text x="205.0" y="265.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">selected result</text>
<line x1="205" y1="276" x2="205" y2="298" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="300" width="330" height="56" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="322.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Flags C, Z, S, V set</text>
<text x="205.0" y="345.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">in status register</text>
<line x1="205" y1="356" x2="205" y2="393" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="205,395.0 365.0,450 205,505.0 45.0,450" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205" y="445.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Jump if zero:</text>
<text x="205" y="467.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Z flag set?</text>
<line x1="365" y1="450" x2="448" y2="450" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="405" y="440" font-size="17" fill="#15803d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="450" y="418" width="320" height="64" rx="10" fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="610.0" y="444.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Branch is taken</text>
<text x="610.0" y="467.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">jump to the new address</text>
<polyline points="205,505 205,545 448,545" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="225" y="532" font-size="17" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="450" y="515" width="320" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="610.0" y="539.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Continue with the</text>
<text x="610.0" y="562.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">next instruction</text>
<rect x="420" y="60" width="360" height="200" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600.0" y="96.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How SUB reuses the adder</text>
<text x="600.0" y="119.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1. Invert operand B</text>
<text x="600.0" y="142.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">2. Set carry in to 1</text>
<text x="600.0" y="165.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">3. Add in the same</text>
<text x="600.0" y="188.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">full adder chain</text>
<text x="600.0" y="211.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Result: A minus B in</text>
<text x="600.0" y="234.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">two’s complement</text>
</svg>

figs.name: arithmetic-logic-unit-4-bit-ripple-carry-infographic
figs.alt: arithmetic logic unit 4 bit ripple carry adder example 1011 plus 0110 with carry and flags
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog working through 1011 plus 0110 in four chained full adders, giving 10001 or 17, with carry flag set and zero, sign and overflow flags clear.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>4 bit ripple carry addition example 1011 plus 0110 equals 10001 with flags</title>
<rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Worked Example: 1011 + 0110 in a 4 Bit Adder</text>
<text x="400" y="78" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">A = 1011 (11), B = 0110 (6), carry ripples right to left</text>
<rect x="110" y="110" width="130" height="90" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="175.0" y="149.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">FA3</text>
<text x="175.0" y="173.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1 + 0 + 1</text>
<text x="175" y="232" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">S3 = 0</text>
<line x1="280" y1="168" x2="242" y2="168" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="260" y="157" font-size="18" fill="#ea580c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<rect x="280" y="110" width="130" height="90" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="345.0" y="149.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">FA2</text>
<text x="345.0" y="173.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0 + 1 + 1</text>
<text x="345" y="232" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">S2 = 0</text>
<line x1="450" y1="168" x2="412" y2="168" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="430" y="157" font-size="18" fill="#ea580c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<rect x="450" y="110" width="130" height="90" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="515.0" y="149.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">FA1</text>
<text x="515.0" y="173.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1 + 1 + 0</text>
<text x="515" y="232" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">S1 = 0</text>
<line x1="620" y1="168" x2="582" y2="168" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="600" y="157" font-size="18" fill="#ea580c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0</text>
<rect x="620" y="110" width="130" height="90" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="685.0" y="149.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">FA0</text>
<text x="685.0" y="173.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1 + 0 + 0</text>
<text x="685" y="232" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">S0 = 1</text>
<line x1="788" y1="168" x2="742" y2="168" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="768" y="157" font-size="18" fill="#ea580c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0</text>
<text x="765" y="196" font-size="17" fill="#ea580c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Cin</text>
<line x1="110" y1="168" x2="70" y2="168" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="90" y="157" font-size="18" fill="#ea580c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="45" y="196" font-size="17" fill="#ea580c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Cout</text>
<rect x="80" y="260" width="640" height="76" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="292.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Result 0001 with carry out 1, so 1011 + 0110 = 10001</text>
<text x="400.0" y="316.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">In decimal: 11 + 6 = 17</text>
<rect x="20" y="365" width="180" height="104" rx="12" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="110" y="403" font-size="22" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">C = 1</text>
<text x="110" y="440" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">carry out of MSB</text>
<rect x="212" y="365" width="180" height="104" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="302" y="403" font-size="22" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Z = 0</text>
<text x="302" y="440" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">result not zero</text>
<rect x="404" y="365" width="180" height="104" rx="12" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="494" y="403" font-size="22" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">S = 0</text>
<text x="494" y="440" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">MSB of result is 0</text>
<rect x="596" y="365" width="180" height="104" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="686" y="403" font-size="22" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">V = 0</text>
<text x="686" y="440" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">no signed overflow</text>
</svg>
